queries.query: (o:saproling or o:plant or o:treefolk or o:fungus) -t:creature game:paper -is:funny date<=2026-10-21 unique:cards

cards.name: Aloe Alchemist
cards.oracle_text:
Trample
When this card becomes plotted, target creature gets +3/+2 and gains trample until end of turn.
Plot {1}{G} (You may pay {1}{G} and exile this card from your hand. Cast it as a sorcery on a later turn without paying its mana cost. Plot only as a sorcery.)

research.note: Plot can improve a Treefolk or Fungus attacker before this Plant arrives, giving its packet useful play even with a different partner.
research.caution: Plot is a separate timing procedure; the bonus happens when plotted, not when later cast.
research.manaNote: One green source supports either its normal or plot cost.

cards.name: Bayou Groff
cards.oracle_text: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature or pay {3}.

research.note: An inexpensive large Plant can turn a spare Saproling into pressure and makes token-producing partners relevant.
research.caution: The advertised two-mana cost requires sacrificing a creature; without fodder it costs five mana.
research.manaNote: Only one green pip, but its extra three-mana payment must be budgeted when no fodder is available.

cards.name: Bloodbriar
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you sacrifice another permanent, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

research.note: Grows when token sacrifices, Food, or other expendable permanents are used; connects a Plant packet to Fungus engines.
research.caution: Only sacrifice counts, not every creature death. Needs enough actual sacrifice outlets.
research.manaNote: Three mana with a single green pip fits mixed-color packets.

cards.name: Bloom Hulk
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

research.note: A solid body whose proliferate can grow Plant counters and accelerate Fungus spore counters.
research.caution: Proliferate can add counters already present, including -1/-1 counters; it cannot supply the first counter.
research.manaNote: Four mana with one green pip is easy to share with a second color.

cards.name: Blooming Stinger
cards.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
When this creature enters, another target creature you control gains deathtouch until end of turn.

research.note: Deathtouch supplies a useful blocker or attacker independently, while its entry ability can make a partner creature dangerous.
research.caution: The granted deathtouch lasts only for the entry turn; sorcery-speed entry does not protect the next opposing attack.
research.manaNote: Two mana with one green pip.

cards.name: Bristly Bill, Spine Sower
cards.oracle_text:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
{3}{G}{G}: Double the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.

research.note: Land drops grow any creature, so both large Treefolk and expendable Fungus bodies can benefit.
research.caution: Repeated counter doubling can overwhelm a casual packet environment; a power-level candidate rather than an automatic inclusion.
research.manaNote: Early casting needs one green, but its five-mana activation requires two green.

cards.name: Cactusfolk Sureshot
cards.oracle_text:
Reach
Ward {2} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {2}.)
At the beginning of combat on your turn, other creatures you control with power 4 or greater gain trample and haste until end of turn.

research.note: Gives sufficiently large Plants or Treefolk haste and trample while remaining a substantial attacker itself.
research.caution: Its combat trigger checks power four or greater and does not help small Saprolings without other growth.
research.manaNote: Requires both red and green; include reliable access within its own packet.

cards.name: Creeperhulk
cards.oracle_text:
Trample
{1}{G}: Until end of turn, target creature you control has base power and toughness 5/5 and gains trample.

research.note: Can turn a spare Saproling or small Plant into a trampling threat, making tokens useful beyond sacrifice.
research.caution: Setting a defender's base size does not remove defender; repeated activations may make combat swing sharply.
research.manaNote: Five mana requires double green; each activation needs another green.

cards.name: Floriferous Vinewall
cards.oracle_text:
Defender
When this creature enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

research.note: Finds a land while holding the ground, helping either partner's mana requirements.
research.caution: Looks at only six cards and can miss; it is selection rather than guaranteed fixing or ramp.
research.manaNote: Needs green to cast, then can find any land among the looked-at cards.

cards.name: Gatecreeper Vine
cards.oracle_text:
Defender
When this creature enters, you may search your library for a basic land card or a Gate card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

research.note: Finds an appropriate basic or Gate and supplies an expendable blocker for either partner.
research.caution: The land goes to hand; it does not accelerate the number of lands on the battlefield.
research.manaNote: One green starts a guaranteed search for a basic land or Gate, including another color.

cards.name: Ilysian Caryatid
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Add one mana of any color. If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, add two mana of any one color instead.

research.note: Makes any color and upgrades when a large Plant or Treefolk appears; an effective link between creature size and multicolor play.
research.caution: Must survive and lose summoning sickness before producing mana; the two mana must be one color.
research.manaNote: One green to cast; produces any color, or two of one color with a power-four creature.

cards.name: Jaddi Offshoot
cards.oracle_text:
Defender
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 1 life.

research.note: A cheap buffer while Treefolk develop, with landfall life gain useful alongside life-sensitive Fungus cards.
research.caution: Defender and zero power mean it needs another plan to win; do not fill the packet entirely with defensive bodies.
research.manaNote: Single green mana.

cards.name: Living Totem
cards.oracle_text:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
When this creature enters, you may put a +1/+1 counter on another target creature.

research.note: Saprolings can convoke it out and its counter improves any partner's creature.
research.caution: Convoke taps potential blockers or attackers; the entry counter must go on another creature.
research.manaNote: Single green pip; green creatures can help pay it and other creatures can pay generic costs.

cards.name: Phytohydra
cards.oracle_text: If damage would be dealt to this creature, put that many +1/+1 counters on it instead.

research.note: Turns incoming damage into growth and can benefit from Fungus counter-doubling or Plant counter support.

research.manaNote: Five mana with green and double white is demanding for a mixed packet.

cards.name: Phytotitan
cards.oracle_text: When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control at the beginning of their next upkeep.

research.note: A large recurring Plant can supply repeated pressure or recurring sacrifice material.
research.caution: Returns tapped at its owner's next upkeep, leaving a window to act; low toughness makes repeated deaths likely.
research.manaNote: Six mana with double green.

cards.name: Prickly Pair
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 red Mercenary creature token with "{T}: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery."

research.note: Adds two bodies and a token that can enhance any attacker, including a Treefolk or Fungus.
research.caution: Its accompanying token is a Mercenary, not a Plant or Saproling; type-restricted bonuses do not apply.
research.manaNote: Three mana with one red pip; token activation has no colored cost.

cards.name: Rampant Rejuvenator
cards.oracle_text:
This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When this creature dies, search your library for up to X basic land cards, where X is this creature's power, put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle.

research.note: Counter growth increases the land search on death, supplying mana for larger partner cards.
research.caution: The ramp requires dying and basics left in the library; bounced or exiled copies do not provide it.
research.manaNote: Single green to cast; death can find basics of several colors and puts them onto the battlefield.

cards.name: Sabotender
cards.oracle_text:
Reach
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.

research.note: A red Plant that turns ordinary land drops into damage and covers flyers with reach.

research.manaNote: Two mana with one red pip.

cards.name: Rootcoil Creeper
cards.oracle_text:
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
{T}: Add two mana of any one color. Spend this mana only to cast spells from your graveyard.
{G}{U}, {T}, Exile this creature: Return target card with flashback you own from exile to your hand.

cards.name: Vigean Hydropon

cards.name: Vinelasher Kudzu
cards.oracle_text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

research.note: A straightforward threat that grows from normal land drops and appreciates either partner's land search.

cards.name: Wall of Blossoms
cards.oracle_text:
Defender
When this creature enters, draw a card.

research.note: Replaces itself while holding the ground, helping a slow Treefolk partner or a sacrifice-oriented Fungus partner.

cards.name: Wall of Kelp

Defender (This creature can't attack.)

cards.name: Tangletrove Kelp

research.note: A blue Plant finisher that can turn Clue support into a temporary attacking board.
research.caution: Its strongest effect requires Clues; seven mana is high and a Clue package must be deliberate.
research.manaNote: Seven mana including double blue; its sacrifice-for-a-card ability costs only generic mana.

cards.name: Kirri, Talented Sprout
cards.oracle_text:
Other Plants and Treefolk you control get +2/+0.
At the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, return target Plant, Treefolk, or land card from your graveyard to your hand.

research.caution: Does not recur Fungi merely because they are in the same faction; recurring cards plus a blanket power bonus may be strong.

cards.name: Treefolk Harbinger
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a Treefolk or Forest card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.

cards.name: Bosk Banneret

cards.name: Battlewand Oak

Whenever you cast a Treefolk spell, this creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

cards.name: Ambassador Oak

cards.name: Cloudcrown Oak

research.note: A straightforward Treefolk body that can be cast through either green or white, making packet combinations easier.

cards.name: Oaken Brawler

research.note: Provides a straightforward attacker or blocker that replaces itself on death and suits sacrifice partners.
research.caution: Exile or bounce bypasses its draw trigger.
research.manaNote: Three mana with one green pip.

cards.name: Sporecrown Thallid
cards.oracle_text: Each other creature you control that's a Fungus or Saproling gets +1/+1.

research.note: A cheap body that makes the Fungus packet's creatures and Saprolings more threatening.
research.caution: Does not boost other Plant-faction creature types or itself; assess how much of a mixed deck actually benefits.
research.manaNote: Two mana with one green pip.

cards.name: Sporemound
cards.oracle_text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.

research.note: Converts later land drops into Saprolings and works with Plant ramp and land-search cards.
research.caution: At five mana it may arrive after many land drops; avoid pairing with Life and Limb without understanding the forced loop.
research.manaNote: Five mana including double green.

cards.name: Sporesower Thallid
cards.oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a spore counter on each Fungus you control.
Remove three spore counters from this creature: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.

research.note: A substantial Fungus accelerates the rest of a spore-counter plan while retaining a relevant body.
research.caution: Only Fungi receive its counters; a Fungus without an outlet may accumulate counters it cannot use by itself.
research.manaNote: Four mana with double green.

cards.name: Sporoloth Ancient
cards.oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a spore counter on this creature.
Creatures you control have "Remove two spore counters from this creature: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token."

research.note: Makes existing spore counters more efficient and lets any allied creature spend two of its own spore counters for a Saproling.
research.caution: Does not place counters on the whole team; non-Fungus partner creatures usually have none to spend.
research.manaNote: Five mana including double green.

cards.name: Swarm Shambler
cards.oracle_text:
This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it becomes the target of a spell an opponent controls, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token.
{1}, {T}: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

research.note: Protects the value of any counter-bearing creature by making a token when an opposing spell targets it.
research.caution: Its tokens are Insects, not Saprolings; opposing abilities do not trigger the token effect.
research.manaNote: Single green to cast; its growth activation costs one generic mana and tapping.

cards.name: Thallid
cards.oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a spore counter on this creature.
Remove three spore counters from this creature: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.

research.note: A simple starting point for the spore-counter theme and an early body.
research.caution: One Saproling per three unassisted upkeeps is slow; do not use its low mana cost as proof of fast token production.
research.manaNote: Single green mana; creating its token requires counters rather than mana.

cards.name: Tukatongue Thallid
cards.oracle_text: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.

research.note: A cheap creature that leaves a Saproling on death, making early blocks and sacrifices less costly.
research.caution: Requires dying; it provides no bonus if exiled or returned to hand.
research.manaNote: Single green mana.

cards.name: Undercellar Myconid
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever this creature enters or dies, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
{T}: Add one mana of any color.

research.note: Provides a Saproling on entry and death while fixing mana for either partner's large or multicolor cards.
research.caution: Three mana is slower than common two-mana ramp; it must survive a turn to tap for mana.
research.manaNote: Three mana with one green, then taps for any color.

cards.name: Utopia Mycon
cards.oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a spore counter on this creature.
Remove three spore counters from this creature: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
Sacrifice a Saproling: Add one mana of any color.

research.note: Lets Saprolings become mana of any color, connecting token production to larger Plant and Treefolk threats.
research.caution: Only Saprolings can be sacrificed to its mana ability; its own first token takes time.
research.manaNote: Single green to cast; each sacrificed Saproling yields one mana of any color.

cards.name: Yavimaya Sapherd
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.

research.note: A straightforward Fungus plus Saproling offers two bodies for convoke, sacrifice, or creature-count effects.
research.caution: Its small bodies rely on the rest of the deck for a late-game plan.
research.manaNote: Three mana with one green pip.

cards.name: Mycoloth
cards.oracle_text:
Devour 2 (As this creature enters, you may sacrifice any number of creatures. It enters with twice that many +1/+1 counters on it.)
At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token for each +1/+1 counter on this creature.

research.note: Turns spare creatures from either partner into a potentially large recurring Saproling supply.
research.caution: Devour risks several cards to one removal spell; surviving counter growth can overwhelm a modest matchup.
research.manaNote: Five mana with double green; devour sacrifices creatures but adds no mana cost.

cards.name: Fungal Infection
cards.oracle_text: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.

research.note: A low-cost way to shrink or kill a small creature while adding a Saproling for sacrifice and token payoffs.
research.caution: The -1/-1 effect is modest; choose carefully against Zombie cards with one toughness rather than assuming it is universal removal.
research.manaNote: Single black mana.

cards.name: Fungal Rebirth
cards.oracle_text: Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand. If a creature died this turn, create two 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.

research.note: Recovers any permanent from the three themes and can supply Saprolings after combat or a sacrifice.
research.caution: The two tokens require a creature to have died that turn; the recovered card goes to hand rather than the battlefield.
research.manaNote: Three mana with one green pip.

cards.name: Fungal Plots
cards.oracle_text:
{1}{G}, Exile a creature card from your graveyard: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
Sacrifice two Saprolings: You gain 2 life and draw a card.

research.note: Converts spent creature cards into Saprolings and turns spare Saprolings into life and cards.
research.caution: Exiling creature cards can compete with partner recursion; drawing consumes two actual Saprolings.
research.manaNote: Two mana with one green, then green for making a token; drawing has no mana cost.

cards.name: Saproling Migration
cards.oracle_text:
Kicker {4} (You may pay an additional {4} as you cast this spell.)
Create two 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens. If this spell was kicked, create four of those tokens instead.

research.note: A straightforward source of early bodies that can scale later and supports either partner's broad creature effects.
research.caution: The kicker total is six mana; neither mode creates Fungi despite the theme.
research.manaNote: Two mana with one green, or six mana total when kicked.

cards.name: Fists of Ironwood
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, create two 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.
Enchanted creature has trample.

research.note: Makes Saprolings while granting trample to a large Plant or Treefolk, linking the three strategies.
research.caution: An Aura requires a creature target and risks losing its entry trigger if the spell loses that target before resolving.
research.manaNote: Two mana with one green pip.

cards.name: Lignify
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature is a Treefolk with base power and toughness 0/4 and loses all abilities.

research.note: A botanical way to suppress a troublesome creature that is also a Treefolk spell for relevant tribal triggers.
research.caution: Leaves a 0/4 body, does not grant defender, and makes that creature a Treefolk; global Treefolk effects or toughness-damage effects may help it.
research.manaNote: Two mana with one green pip.

cards.name: Rootgrapple
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target noncreature permanent. If you control a Treefolk, draw a card.

research.note: An on-theme answer to a noncreature permanent, with a card back when a Treefolk is present.
research.caution: Cannot target creatures; five mana makes it a deliberate higher-cost interaction slot.
research.manaNote: Five mana with one green pip.

cards.name: Reach of Branches
cards.oracle_text:
Create a 2/5 green Treefolk Shaman creature token.
Whenever a Forest you control enters, you may return this card from your graveyard to your hand.

research.note: Produces a substantial Treefolk token and can return to hand after later Forest drops.
research.caution: Repeated casting costs five mana each time; non-Forest lands do not recover it.
research.manaNote: Single green in a five-mana cost; recurrence specifically requires Forests.

cards.name: Insidious Roots
cards.oracle_text:
Creature tokens you control have "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, create a 0/1 green Plant creature token, then put a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.

research.note: Connects graveyard movement to Plant tokens and gives all creature tokens a way to fix mana, including Saprolings.
research.caution: Needs creature cards to leave the controller's graveyard; milling alone does not trigger it, and the counters only go on actual Plants.
research.manaNote: Black and green to cast; token mana abilities can then supply other colors once summoning sickness permits.

cards.name: Artifact Mutation
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target artifact. It can't be regenerated. Create X 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens, where X is that artifact's mana value.

research.note: Transforms an opposing artifact into Saprolings, supplying interaction and Fungus resources in one botanical spell.
research.caution: Needs a legal artifact target; destroying an ordinary zero-mana-value token produces no Saprolings.
research.manaNote: Requires red and green at two mana.

cards.name: Aura Mutation
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target enchantment. Create X 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens, where X is that enchantment's mana value.

research.note: Destroys an enchantment while developing the Saproling plan, giving a white component a clear mechanical role.
research.caution: Can be dead when no enchantments are available; number of tokens depends on the target's mana value.
research.manaNote: Requires green and white at two mana.

cards.name: Aether Mutation
cards.oracle_text: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Create X 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens, where X is that creature's mana value.

research.note: Returns a creature and makes Saprolings equal to its mana value, giving blue a botanical way to create a board.
research.caution: Bouncing a creature lets its owner recast it, and tokens or low-cost targets generate little additional value.
research.manaNote: Five mana requiring green and blue.

cards.name: Seed Spark
cards.oracle_text: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. If {G} was spent to cast this spell, create two 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.

research.note: White interaction can also make Saprolings when its cost is paid partly with green, supporting a shared green base.
research.caution: The token bonus needs green mana actually spent; merely controlling green permanents is insufficient.
research.manaNote: Costs 3W; one of the generic mana payments can be green to enable its bonus.

cards.name: Pollenbright Wings
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has flying.
Whenever enchanted creature deals combat damage to a player, create that many 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.

research.note: A large Plant or Treefolk can become a flying attacker that produces Saprolings for the Fungus plan.
research.caution: Six-mana Aura risks a major loss to removal; repeated connections can rapidly dominate the board.
research.manaNote: Six mana requiring green and white.
